## Checklist

- [ ] One theme per pull request, and only files inside `themes/<theme-id>/`
- [ ] `theme.json` id matches the folder name
- [ ] `preview.png` (or .jpg/.webp) included, ideally 1280×720
- [ ] Only `theme.json`, `styles.css`, the preview, an optional `README.md` and images/fonts in `assets/`
- [ ] No `url(...)` to the internet and no `@import` (local files in `assets/` only)
- [ ] I made this theme, or I have the right to share every image and font in it
- [ ] Tested on: <!-- Windows 10 / Windows 11 -->
- [ ] I ran `npm run validate` locally (optional, CI runs it too)
